preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest sequence of nodes recorded by Bob.
The length of the output sequence must be equal to the number of nodes n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= node <= n for node in result)
postconditions.description: All nodes in the output sequence must be valid node indices between 1 and n.
